change: Read-only exact-ELF audit of broad-PGO pre-MMU counter leakage
hypothesis: Instrumented target dependencies are inlined into unprofiled someboot functions before MMU and console setup
difference: Resolves exact counter sites and profiled record owners in the current b292 run880 ELF without another crate-range board experiment
effect: Existing ELF disassembly finds fdt_raw-owned ldxr/stxr counter updates in someboot::fdt::earlycon::setup_earlycon before the first console output; the first site is 0xffffffff80bc06cc. Log and allocator-shim counters also appear in someboot functions. The valid four-crate training ELF has no such someboot counter sites. Run880 has no ESR, so its exact stopping PC remains an inference.
decision: No performance claim. Next experiment should exclude measured counter owners from generate and use, statically verify pre-MMU someboot functions are counter-free, then board-test only if that gate passes.
